Position Summary 
 
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Headquartered in Plano, TX, Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.

The Systems Support Group is a technically driven team responsible for building and managing an interconnected ecosystem of systems that work together to keep operations running efficiently. At the core of everything we do is strong Python development and SQL expertise.They are the foundation of how we build, automate, and manage the systems we own. Our APIs serve as the connective tissue between platforms, our Airflow pipelines orchestrate the flow of work across those systems, our ETL processes ensure data moves cleanly and reliably from one place to another, and our Python solutions tie it all together with automation and logic that scales.
Each system we manage plays a specific role in a larger connected workflow. An API feeds data into a pipeline, that pipeline triggers an ETL process, and the cleaned output powers dashboards, downstream systems, and decision-making tools. Every component has a purpose, and every purpose feeds into the bigger picture.
The next step in our journey is the development of an Agentic AI System. The vision is ambitious. A system that sits across all of our existing platforms, monitors them in real time, reasons through issues as they arise, and takes intelligent action autonomously. This is not something we are plugging in off the shelf. It is something we are engineering with intention, pushing the boundaries of what intelligent automation can look like in a live systems environment.
This is a real opportunity to work on advanced, forward thinking solutions and be part of something that is actively evolving. If you are someone who gets excited about building sophisticated systems, solving complex problems, and taking AI solutions beyond the basics into something truly impactful, this is exactly the kind of work we are doing and we want you to be part of it. 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
 Python, React, Django, FastAPI, SQL/NoSQL databases, Unix OS, and Bash scripting
 Experience building Agentic AI solutions
 Airflow, SQL Experience
 Communication and  Onsite Collaboration
 Eager to Learn and Like Challenge
 
 Skills and Qualifications 
 
 Academic Major Preferred: Undergrad in Computer Science, AI Model Trainning, Agentic AI


  #LI-HM1

 Life @ Samsung - https://www.samsung.com/us/careers/life-at-samsung/ 
 Benefits @ Samsung - https://www.samsung.com/us/careers/benefits/
